{{- /* One list of tables of data/labels.toml by its dotted key, for example "artifact_group" or "checklist.warning" (ADR-0004 part 13). Called with a dict and returns the list: key the dotted key fields the keys every entry must carry as a non-empty string A missing or empty list, an entry that is not a table, or an entry without one of its fields fails the build with errorf naming the key, so a list never renders an empty heading or item. label.html reads single strings; together they are the only readers of data/labels.toml. */ -}} {{- $key := .key -}} {{- $v := hugo.Data.labels -}} {{- range split $key "." -}} {{- if reflect.IsMap $v }}{{ $v = index $v . }}{{ else }}{{ $v = "" }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not (and (reflect.IsSlice $v) $v) -}} {{- errorf "label-list.html: data/labels.toml has no non-empty list at %q" $key -}} {{- end -}} {{- $fields := .fields -}} {{- range $i, $entry := $v -}} {{- if not (reflect.IsMap $entry) -}} {{- errorf "label-list.html: entry %d of %q in data/labels.toml is not a table" (add $i 1) $key -}} {{- end -}} {{- range $fields -}} {{- $s := index $entry . -}} {{- if not (and (eq (printf "%T" $s) "string") $s) -}} {{- errorf "label-list.html: entry %d of %q in data/labels.toml has no string %q" (add $i 1) $key . -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $v -}}
